# Sujan Mongar

> Bhutanese Product Designer (UX/UI), based in Thimphu, Bhutan, available for freelance work and collaborations worldwide.

Sujan Mongar designs clear, usable, and scalable digital products for startups and growing
businesses. His work spans UX audits, user research, usability testing, wireframing, high-fidelity
UI, and design systems, for both web and mobile products.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sujanmongar.com/): Introduction and featured case studies.
- [Work](https://sujanmongar.com/work/): Full list of UX/UI case studies.
- [About](https://sujanmongar.com/about/): Background, focus areas, and experience.

## Case studies

- [Cab Booking Platform for Bhutan](https://sujanmongar.com/work/cab-booking-platform-for-bhutan/): A mobile-responsive cab-booking platform (DrukDrive) for tourists, locals, and long-distance travelers across Bhutan. A coded, clickable demo of the design is at https://drukdrive.vercel.app/.
- [OneClickShop — Website Revamp](https://sujanmongar.com/work/oneclickshop-website-revamp/): A complete e-commerce redesign for an online grocery and home-delivery service in Thimphu, Bhutan.
- [Arogaro — Bhutan's First Matchmaking App](https://sujanmongar.com/work/arogaro-matchmaking-app/): A mobile-first matchmaking app built around verified profiles and trust. A coded landing page for the app is at https://arogaro.pages.dev/.
- [BazaGuru — Digital Chanting App for Bhutan](https://sujanmongar.com/work/bazaguru-digital-chanting-app/): A digital chanting and prayer companion app bringing mantra counting into a mobile-first product.
